checks: One reference image supplies the fixed 4096-descriptor bank; no query fitting.
64 separate normal DEV images calibrate the strict-maximum operating threshold.
Native tile coordinates and stride-2 feature centers are preserved for interpolation; TEST masks are not resized.
RGB predictions occur before per-image labels, with pixel target loading reserved for scoring after prediction.
Exact pixel AUROC/AP and image rank metrics handle ties; false positives per 10000 are scaled from actual normal TEST count with uncertainty.
No borrowed pretrained weights or real-image gradient updates are introduced by the scorer.

corrected_findings.issue: Malformed DEV results could omit an expected method or checkpoint map entry.
corrected_findings.resolution: validate_final_dev_rosters now requires exact method keys for score_files/calibration/thresholds and exact learned_final/random keys for checkpoints/provenance, with primary learned_final.

corrected_findings.issue: CLI protocol identity needed an early equality check against the TEST admission.
corrected_findings.resolution: verify_test_admission_matches compares the protocol SHA before dataset/engine access.

other_confirmed: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG is set before importing torch-dependent modules.
Evaluation records own-process peak CUDA allocated and reserved bytes.
limitations: This is a source review, not a second independent implementation or empirical TEST replication.
One-reference bank fitting still uses 64 additional normal DEV calibration images.
Stride-2 descriptor sampling and interpolation may limit finest-pixel localization.
FP per 10000 extrapolates from a small normal TEST set and is not a 10000-negative empirical test.
